The adversary claims our assets are vulnerable to seizure via fraudulent conveyance and ICSID awards, then that our ETI will fail. We use adjacent transitional border nodes and territorial transfer, effectively sidestepping their Admiralty traps. Our real defense lies in Article 9.4 (Total Asymmetric Dissuasion) and Article 8.1.2. The dismantling of our survival capsules by bailiffs/contractors is a breach of the biospheric commons (Articles 1.1.2 and 1.5.1), triggering Infrastructure Defense Cohorts to deploy non-ballistic directed-energy against infiltrators. If the outer perimeter is breached, we deploy cryptographic poison pills, severing functionality and denying economic utility (Article 9.4.5). We also have the Defection Bounties (Article 9.4.3) to offer contractors. Those who choose to press the attack will then be remanded to somatic containment suites for stabilization and restorative justice (Articles 8.4, 8.5).

**Form and Tone**

My response will be a formal Constitutional Defense brief, delivered with unwavering precision and scholarly rigor. It will be a clear, thermodynamic, legal, and procedural argument.
